# Research Guides at New Jersey Institute of Technology

> NJIT's comprehensive research guides platform providing subject-specific resources, library tutorials, and academic research support for students and faculty.

The Research Guides site serves the New Jersey Institute of Technology community through LibGuides, offering curated resources across disciplines, getting-started tutorials, citation management tools, and direct access to librarian support. The platform integrates with NJIT's library systems including Robert W. Van Houten Library and provides both on-campus and remote access solutions.

## Key Topics

- New Jersey Institute of Technology (NJIT)
- Robert W. Van Houten Library

## Getting Started

- [Home - Research Guides at New Jersey Institute of Technology](https://researchguides.njit.edu): NJIT Research Guides homepage with subject guides and library resources
- [Starting Your Research](https://researchguides.njit.edu/start-research): Getting started guide for NJIT research using Library Search and resources
- [Off Campus Access](https://researchguides.njit.edu/remoteaccess): Guide to off-campus access via OpenAthens and NJIT UCID authentication
- [Introduction to the Littman Library](https://researchguides.njit.edu/introduction): Introduction to Littman Library services and circulation policies
- [Find a Book in the NJIT Library](https://researchguides.njit.edu/findbook): Tutorial for finding books in Robert W. Van Houten Library catalog

## Citation & Reference Management

- [Zotero Citation Manager Tutorial](https://researchguides.njit.edu/zotero): Tutorial for Zotero citation manager and bibliography management
- [Mendeley Reference Manager](https://researchguides.njit.edu/mendeley): Getting started guide for Mendeley reference manager and citation tools

## Subject Research Guides

- [Humanities Research](https://researchguides.njit.edu/humanities): Introduction to Humanities Research resources and library support
- [Data & Statistics](https://researchguides.njit.edu/statistics): Research guide for data and statistics resources by Annelise Sklar
- [Black History, Culture, and Literature](https://researchguides.njit.edu/BlackHistory): Subject research guide for Black History, Culture, and Literature
- [Women's History at NJIT](https://researchguides.njit.edu/WomensHistory): Subject research guide for Women's History at NJIT
- [Color & Composition](https://researchguides.njit.edu/colorandcomposition): Art research guide covering color, composition, and formal analysis

## Library Services & Support

- [Ask A Librarian - Research Help](https://researchguides.njit.edu/researchhelp): Ask A Librarian contact information and research help desk hours
- [Subject Liaison Librarian Program](https://researchguides.njit.edu/subject-liaison): Directory of NJIT subject liaison librarians and department contacts
- [Group Study Room Reservations](https://researchguides.njit.edu/services/group-study-rooms): Van Houten Library group study room reservation policy and booking

## Course & Program Guides

- [Freshman Seminar](https://researchguides.njit.edu/Freshman): Freshman Seminar information literacy and research skills assessment
- [CHE 370 - Heat and Mass Transfer](https://researchguides.njit.edu/CHE370): Course-specific research guide for CHE 370 Heat and Mass Transfer

## Optional

- [Concert Hall in Prague](https://researchguides.njit.edu/prague): Research guide for Prague concert hall project with interlibrary loan
